persona.mission: Create a Swiss-style, high-contrast, minimalist productivity app that fuses digital precision with calm routine.
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss Print Design x Digital Product.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'crisp' and 'rewarding'.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Remove unnecessary chrome.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to separate days and tasks, not lines.

setup_instructions: CRITICAL: This project requires NativeWind for styling. Run the following commands immediately:
yarn add nativewind tailwindcss react-native-reanimated react-native-safe-area-context
Create global.css and import it in the root _layout file.

universal_rules: Mobile-First: All layouts must be thumb-friendly.
Touch Targets: Minimum 44x44pt for all interactive elements.
Safe Area: Respect top and bottom safe areas using SafeAreaView.
Keyboard: Wrap forms in KeyboardAvoidingView with behavior='padding'.
Tab Navigation: Use Expo Router tabs with a translucent blur effect.

buttons.primary: bg-primary px-6 py-4 rounded-lg flex-row justify-center items-center shadow-sm active:opacity-90
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-border px-6 py-4 rounded-lg flex-row justify-center items-center

cards.base: bg-surface border border-border p-5 rounded-xl shadow-none

inputs.base: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-border py-3 px-1 text-lg font-medium focus:border-primary
inputs.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground mb-1

checkbox.style: w-6 h-6 rounded-full border-2 border-muted-foreground items-center justify-center

morning_routine_template.usage: Cover image for Morning Routine Template card

evening_routine_template.usage: Cover image for Evening Routine Template card

hero_abstract.usage: Background for Login/Auth Screen or Empty State

micro_interactions.press: Scale down to 0.96 on pressIn, spring back on pressOut
micro_interactions.task_completion: Strikethrough text animation + Checkbox fill spring

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use a font with more character if possible, or bold system font.
Do NOT use generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for text to maintain reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. 'p-4' is too small; use 'p-6' or 'p-8'.
Avoid gradients for text. Use solid high-contrast colors.
Ensure all touch targets are at least 44px by 44px.
Use Haptics (expo-haptics) for all success actions (checking a box, saving a task).
Always wrap scrollable areas in ScrollView or FlatList.
Use SafeAreaView to prevent content from being hidden behind notches/home bars.
